description: This file defines a GUI component named BitConfigField for configuring bit-based fields in a hardware configuration application. It creates a checkbox UI element that reflects and updates a specific bit in a configuration data structure, listens for messages updating the bit's value, and loads the current value from a configuration image.

classes.name: BitConfigField
classes.description: A GUI component for editing a specific bit within a configuration field, using a JCheckBox to represent and modify the bit.

methods.name: BitConfigField
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the UI, initializes the checkbox, registers message listener, and adds action listener for user interaction.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the checkbox state based on a boolean value, avoiding recursive events with the 'ec' flag.

methods.name: loadValue
methods.description: Loads the current bit value from a configuration image and updates the checkbox accordingly.
